title: Forms, text fields, focus and the keyboard

videos.script: A form is where a person types, and typing is where an app meets the mess. {{draft}} A field holds text, all the time. Four, then forty-five. Empty, while an old number is deleted. So the planner keeps two things apart. A draft, which is what was typed. And a session, which is what the plan keeps. {{rules}} The rules between them are plain Swift. They go in the package, and you test them on any computer. Every problem at once, as values, never as sentences. {{day}} Then the quiet failure. A date picker hands over an instant, not a day. Half past eleven at night in São Paulo is already tomorrow in UTC. You will see it happen. {{screen}} Then the screen, written from Apple's documentation, because there is no Mac in this recording. A Form, two sections, a picker and two fields. {{focus}} Focus that moves to the field that is wrong, instead of a button that just goes grey. {{keys}} And the keyboard: the field it covers, the key it does not have, and how to make it go away.
